correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the orbit classification from homogeneity and the complement/cut translation action; checked cut-space dimensions and exceptional small arities; exhaustive labeled-graph orbit enumeration through five distinct vertices and Stirling-transform checks through arity eight agree exactly.

originality.rationale: Targeted published-finding corpus and literature searches for the exact powers, switching/complement variants, sequence prefixes, and stronger-equivalent profile statements found no match; the closest structural and orbit-growth papers do not state the unified formulas. This is best-of-knowledge rather than independent certification.

value.rationale: The finding converts the qualitative five-reduct classification into exact injective and full ordered-tuple profiles at every arity and shows that the five groups are distinguished by tuple-orbit counts by arity four.
